status: predeclared before any selection-range (5000..5015) array was generated
purpose: Run the declared V5 development grid and selection grid (V5_DESIGN.md sequence step 2) and choose one configuration with the selection rule in v5_acceptance_predeclared.json. This does not open validation or OOD seeds and does not evaluate promotion.
declaration: v5_acceptance_predeclared.json is unchanged; its tolerance, metrics and selection rule apply as written.

development.use: descriptive results retained in full; not used to choose the configuration

selection.use: the only data that decides the configuration

cases: All eleven families with the unchanged v0.4 generators and sensor-noise rule, in all six regimes. Selection cases are built from the same generator calls as v4_scenarios.generate_scenarios with the selection seeds; equivalence is tested on the development and known splits.
arms: v5_development.study_arms(): five baselines, the twelve declared development variants (v4_hybrid listed once) and the two matched action-space arms v5_full/capped and v5_no_balance/catalog, 18 arms per case and regime.
eligibility_note: Exactly development.variants, each in its native action space. The matched action-space arms are reported but not eligible.

selection_rule.computed_on: selection split only, all 176 cases per regime, paired by case
order: loss_endpoint_failures: count of the 36 checks (6 regimes x capacity_v2, capacity_balance x total_dropped, end_deficit, tail_auc_deficit) where config mean > baseline mean + tolerance
risk_failures: count of the 24 checks (6 regimes x v3_full, capacity_v2, capacity_balance, v4_hybrid) where config risk > baseline risk + tolerance
selection_rule.risk: CVaR90 with fractional boundary of max(mean_deficit(config) - mean_deficit(static), 0) across the regime's cases, v4_metrics._cvar_last_axis
selection_rule.result: lowest tuple wins; all ties broken by the following key

sensitivity: Report the same ranking on the development split and on development plus selection. These rankings do not change the chosen configuration.
verification: the explicit-seed case builder reproduces v4_scenarios.generate_scenarios manifests exactly for the development and known splits
development cases 2000..2007 match the frozen development scenario manifest (v5_development.development_cases)

on 4000..4063, per-regime means of v4_hybrid, capacity_v2 and capacity_balance and risks of v4_hybrid, v3_full, capacity_v2 and capacity_balance match v4_results/validation/decision.json within the tolerance
every seed file holds 11 families x 6 regimes x 18 arms with physical accounting checks passed
rerunning one selection seed reproduces its file byte for byte
no closed-range seed is generated or evaluated

outputs.rows: local_runs/v5_grid/<split>/episodes-<seed>.csv (not committed; per-seed SHA-256 recorded in the summaries)
outputs.committed: v5_results/selection/summary.json, v5_results/development_grid/summary.json and the Thai report V5_SELECTION_TH.md

after_selection: The chosen configuration becomes the candidate for the remaining declared steps (OOD adapters, evaluator, freeze, reproduction, then validation). Promotion stays NOT_EVALUATED.
